info.title: REST RC7030 API
info.description:
Welcome to the REST RC7030 API. This API lets you interact with the RC7030 services with anything that can send an HTTP request.

-------- DRAFT --------

Overview

The REST API in RC7030 is implemented using HTTP and REST principles. It is defined with the following aspects:
  • - The base URL for the API: http://host/api/1.0 with digest authentication
  • - The internet media type of the data supported: JSON
    • - The set of operations using HTTP methods: GET for retrieving objects , PUT for updating objects, POST for creating objects and DELETE for deleting objects.
  • - Appropriate HTTP status codes to indicate errors.
